root.label: Brookings report on state promise programs and financial aid

events.label: Brookings report on state promise programs and financial aid

slots.name: state grant average
slots.sentence: In 2023-24, undergraduate students received, on average, $1,280 in support from state grants, up nearly 40% from a decade earlier.

slots.name: higher education spending
slots.sentence: States spent $134 billion on higher education in fiscal year 2025 with $16.8 billion (around 11%) going toward student financial aid—a share that has been slightly increasing over time .

slots.name: lottery aid revenue
slots.sentence: In 2024, 10 states relied on $2.75 billion in lottery revenues to support 45 aid programs serving roughly 1 million recipients

slots.name: need based grant share
slots.sentence: In 2023-24, states spent an average of 74% of their grant dollars on need-based programs.

slots.name: Kalamazoo enrollment effect
slots.sentence: Studies find that this generous, “first-dollar” scholarship increased immediate college enrollment by 8 percentage points and six-year credential attainment by 10 percentage points.

slots.name: Tennessee enrollment effect
slots.sentence: Knox Achieves, a local Tennessee program later scaled to the statewide Tennessee Promise, increased both enrollment and degree completion .

slots.name: MassEducate allowance
slots.sentence: For example, Massachusetts’ MassEducate program provides an additional $1,200 allowance for lower‑income recipients.
